Caffeine Crawl in The District

  1. Home
  2. Caffeine Crawl in The District
By Bailey Rizzo
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:18
Instaread

The 7th edition of the Caffeine Crawl in The District returns on Saturday, featuring four different routes, each with its own timeframe and lineup of local coffee and tea shops. Choose the one that best matches your style and get ready to sip and explore what downtown Columbia has to offer.

  • Route 1 (8:30 to noon): Wilder Coffeehouse at The Tiger Hotel, Shortwave Coffee, Acola Coffee, Fretboard Coffee
  • Route 2 (9:30 a.m. – 12:30 p.m.): Wilder Coffeehouse at The Tiger Hotel, Shortwave Coffee, Hexagon Alley, Fretboard Coffee, Bubblecup Tea Zone
  • Route 3 (10:30 a.m. – 1:40 p.m.): Wilder Coffeehouse at The Tiger Hotel, Acola Coffee, Fretboard Coffee, Wynnsome Cake & Tea, Clementine’s Ice Cream
  • Route 4 (10:30 a.m. – 2 p.m.): Acola Coffee, Shortwave Coffee, Hexagon Alley, Clementine’s Ice Cream

At each stop, you’ll enjoy a sample drink paired with an educational talk, demo or presentation on specialty coffee or tea. You’ll also have time to shop, ask questions and connect with industry pros. Each route is under a mile, making it easy to walk or bike, with a route leader to guide the way. Each route will end at The District office for a presentation at tasting.

The Caffeine Crawl costs $36.50 per person. Click here to purchase your tickets.
